title: Victoria Zodiac Boat Whale Watching Adventure
includes: Whale Sightings Guarantee—complimentary tours from all locations until you see whales (fees apply).
$5 per person Salish Sea Conservation Fee (1% For The Planet Initiative) is included in price
Whale and marine life watching tour on a 12-passenger open-aired zodiac boat
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
There is a minimum passenger height restriction of 4ft (120cm) and 50 lbs (23kg)
Each passenger is required to sign a Release of Liability at check in. Participants must be 19 years of age, or require a parent or guardian to sign on their behalf
Subject to favorable weather conditions. If canceled due to poor weather, you will be given the option of an alternative date/time/vessel or full refund
Prince of Whales reserves the right to ask that the credit card used in the booking be presented at check-in, and/or photo ID be presented.
Not suitable for participants with back or neck problems, pregnant women, participants with recent surgeries, heart problems or serious medical conditions
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Join us as we head out in search of marine wildlife in the waters of British Columbia on this 3-hour whale-watching adventure in Victoria! Hop aboard your open-air vessel in Victoria’s inner harbour and enjoy an intimate wildlife experience for the adventurous at heart! The zodiac is custom built for exploring the Salish Sea. Keep a sharp lookout for whales, pinnipeds and other marine wildlife! Discover the beauty of Victoria on our whale watching tour, starting from the picturesque Inner Harbour and cruising past the iconic Ogden Point Terminal, with sights of the majestic Legislative Building, the charming Fisherman’s Wharf, the historic Empress Hotel, and the Royal BC Museum’s buildings.
